import cv2

    # Read the image using OpenCV

    # Check if the image was read successfully
    if image is None:
        print("Error reading the image")
        return

    # Define the colors
    foreground = np.array([255, 255, 255], dtype=np.uint8)
    background = np.array([0, 0, 0], dtype=np.uint8)

    # Traverse the image
    for row_index in range(image.shape[0]):
        for column_index in range(image.shape[1]):
            pixel_value = image[row_index, column_index]

            # Check if the pixel is not the foreground color
            if not np.array_equal(pixel_value, foreground):
                image[row_index, column_index] = background

    # Check if the image needs to be converted to BGR format for OpenCV
    if len(image.shape) == 3 and image.shape[2] == 4:
        image = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_RGBA2BGRA)

    # Save the modified image to the specified destination
    cv2.imwrite(destination_path, image)

    print("Image modified and saved to", destination_path)
